scope: Replace charging-management services across home, workplace and public use, including independent financial and roaming delivery. Broader energy/platform offerings remain explicit catalogue items.

statuses.foundation: Relevant code exists; complete product outcome and field parity remain unproven.
statuses.missing: No implemented end-to-end outcome was found in the reviewed baseline.

evidenceRule: Documented means advertised in a primary source. Unverified means not established by the reviewed sources, never absent. Package/device restrictions and contradictory claims stay visible.

gates.name: Design and observation
gates.description: Polished role-based prototype and read-only historical reconciliation. ThreeForce remains the live manager. G0 proves product understanding and data handling, not replacement readiness.

gates.name: Home/employer service
gates.description: Customer/employee accounts, charging, money, support, privacy and recovery work end to end. This is an engineering milestone; it does not authorize switching a customer who also needs G2 features.

gates.name: Home, workplace and public replacement
gates.description: All applicable G1 and G2 features are proven, independent roaming/payment/installer arrangements exist, and the actual customer’s contract has a signed-off parity manifest. This is the broad charging-service replacement target.

gates.name: Full platform and energy expansion
gates.description: Reseller platform, broad AC/DC/depot capability and additional energy products. Keep these in the register; include them in a customer’s gate whenever their existing service depends on them.

features.name: Customer login, recovery and MFA
features.currentEvidence: Real local Worker/D1 accounts at /service: verified-email development flow, MFA/recovery codes, password recovery, SQL rate limits, session expiry/revocation. Public delivery and production recovery remain unproven.
features.acceptance: Invite and recover an account; verify MFA, session expiry and revocation without leaking station authority.

features.name: Organizations and tenant isolation
features.currentEvidence: Separate SQL organization/membership boundary with cross-tenant read/write/audit and role tests. No commercial station claiming, household grants or tenant OCPP runtime yet.
features.acceptance: Two unrelated employers and households cannot read or command one another’s stations; permission checks cover every route and export.

features.name: Employee invitations and assignments
features.currentEvidence: Persistent role invitations plus immutable dated member/vehicle/card-alias/station-alias/cost-center assignments to an exact policy version. Offboarding closes future business eligibility; physical station/card authority remains separate.
features.acceptance: Assign employee, vehicle, card, charger and cost center with effective dates; joining/leaving changes future eligibility without rewriting history.

features.name: Card linking and business/private eligibility
features.currentEvidence: Owner RFID registry plus commercial non-secret card/vehicle/employee aliases and dated eligibility. Actual commercial card linking, device claiming and owner-scoped business grants remain incomplete.
features.acceptance: Separate household, employee and guest credentials; reimbursement applies only to eligible sessions and periods.

features.name: Authenticated charger connectivity
features.currentEvidence: server/gateway.ts: provisioned OCPP 1.6J stations and bounded connections.
features.acceptance: Authenticate the declared device; reject unknown identities and duplicates; recover after network interruption with stable transaction identity.

features.name: Session and meter history
features.currentEvidence: server/events.ts and server/projections.ts: durable observations, replay collapse and stop conflicts.
features.acceptance: Compare real start/meter/stop records to device exports; duplicates never create extra kWh or money; incomplete and conflicting records stay visible.

features.name: Verified charging through outages
features.currentEvidence: Local-list checks and Freedom recorder exist; exact-device field proof remains absent.
features.acceptance: Known owner delivers real energy during WAN/backend/edge loss and isolated restart; unknown credentials fail; buffered data reconciles after reconnect.

features.name: Remote session start and stop
features.currentEvidence: Not exposed by ChargeGateway or owner API.
features.acceptance: Verify card ownership and authority; show requested, acknowledged and observed outcomes; reject stale/foreign commands and surface timeout uncertainty.

features.name: Reset, connector unlock and availability
features.currentEvidence: No operator command lifecycle.
features.acceptance: Owner-authorized command on supported firmware; actual response/status is shown, affected users are informed, and safe recovery is demonstrated.

features.name: Diagnostics and bounded configuration
features.currentEvidence: Capability inspection and three-key continuity preparation only.
features.acceptance: Retrieve redacted diagnostics; configure only supported writable settings with audit, confirmation and post-change inspection.

features.name: Firmware maintenance
features.currentEvidence: Firmware changes are explicitly outside Genesis.
features.acceptance: Validate supported vendor artifact, authorization, maintenance window, failed-update handling and post-update offline behavior on each claimed device.

features.name: Schedules and charging modes
features.currentEvidence: No schedules or charging profiles.
features.acceptance: Persist schedule with timezone/DST and manual override; show device acknowledgement, conflicts and offline behavior.

features.name: Local dynamic load limits
features.currentEvidence: No site meter or power-control loop.
features.acceptance: On a supported site, load remains within configured physical limits with multiple vehicles and cloud loss; preserve the existing local protection system.

features.name: Solar and low-price optimization
features.currentEvidence: Energy adapters are future architecture.
features.acceptance: Use verified meter/tariff inputs; explain the selected plan, respect ready-by and power constraints, and support immediate owner override.

features.name: Versioned reimbursement policies and tariffs
features.currentEvidence: Persistent immutable policy key/version, effective dates, explicit EUR/kWh and exact rounding; assignments select one fixed version. Real customer/tax/regional rules and independently accepted policy evidence remain unproven.
features.acceptance: Record employer-approved rate, region if applicable, eligibility, effective dates, rounding and currency; explain the exact rule used per session.

features.name: Calculation and finance approval
features.currentEvidence: Server-calculated, byte-provenanced immutable drafts with separate-reviewer current-TOTP approval, exact snapshot checks, eligibility holds and atomic duplicate-session reservations. Local synthetic proof only; actual provider/customer acceptance remains open.
features.acceptance: Approved kWh and monetary totals reproduce independently; exclude unresolved meter/identity conflicts; approval freezes a versioned statement.

features.name: Invoices, reimbursement statements and corrections
features.currentEvidence: Frozen unpaid statements with rejected revisions and approved correction/cancellation chains. Separate-person MFA review appends hash-linked differences; originals and root session reservations are retained. Statutory invoices/credit notes, accounting handoff and settled-payment corrections remain absent.
features.acceptance: Produce numbered documents with source-session traceability and reviewed applicable accounting treatment; corrections reference prior records and never silently replace them.

features.name: Collection, payouts and bank matching
features.currentEvidence: No funding, banking or settlement integration.
features.acceptance: Payment execution and funding are agreed; retries are idempotent, failures are handled, and Paid appears only after reliable settlement confirmation.

features.name: Subscriptions and service-fee billing
features.currentEvidence: No subscription or billing lifecycle.
features.acceptance: Enroll, change and cancel a plan with clear effective dates, transparent fees and reproducible invoices.

features.name: Financial exceptions and disputes
features.currentEvidence: Source/eligibility holds, closed-code rejection, reviewed unpaid adjustments/cancellation and current-balance review flags exist. Owned dispute cases, failed-bank-payment evidence and post-settlement recovery remain missing.
features.acceptance: Missing session, wrong rate and failed payout each get an owner, evidence, next action and resolution; unaffected approved amounts can proceed.

features.name: Employer cost centers and reporting
features.currentEvidence: Dated cost-center assignments and per-employee financial statements exist. Cost-center aggregation, budgets and customer reporting/export acceptance remain unimplemented.
features.acceptance: Reconcile driver, site, card, cost-center and invoice views to the same ledger; approved totals and exported totals agree.

features.name: Guest and third-party charging settlement
features.currentEvidence: Unknown tags rejected; no guest commercial identity/tariff.
features.acceptance: Owner opts in; guest rate is disclosed; reimburse the correct beneficiary; guest sessions never become employee reimbursement accidentally.

features.name: Polished driver mobile experience
features.currentEvidence: Preact owner/engineering console; no consumer driver flow.
features.acceptance: Phone-first home, charger, activity, money and help flows work with loading, empty, offline, pending, error and recovery states.

features.name: Traceable reimbursement timeline
features.currentEvidence: Driver-scoped statement/adjustment journal, both-snapshot evidence, current approved balances and explicit unpaid/cancelled/replaced states. Funding, instruction, bank confirmation and a settled timeline remain absent.
features.acceptance: Every amount links to sessions, policy, approval, funding, settlement and any exception; expected dates are labelled estimates.

features.name: Notifications and actionable status
features.currentEvidence: No notification delivery subsystem.
features.acceptance: Deliver deduplicated session/fault/payment alerts with preferences, localization and a useful next action; retry without exposing private data.

features.name: Public map, filters, prices and availability
features.currentEvidence: No public location or tariff catalogue.
features.acceptance: Display licensed locations, connector compatibility, fresh status, full known price and navigation; show freshness and unsupported pricing explicitly.

features.name: Roaming card issuance and lifecycle
features.currentEvidence: Local owner RFID identifiers are not roaming tokens/contracts.
features.acceptance: Issue, activate, link, block and replace a real interoperable card; track propagation; a blocked card cannot create a newly authorized online session.

features.name: Outbound roaming and imported charge records
features.currentEvidence: No OCPI/eMSP integration or external CDR pipeline.
features.acceptance: Real card works on the agreed external network; final records, tariff changes, disputes and reversals reconcile to customer billing.

features.name: Inbound roaming for operated chargers
features.currentEvidence: No partner authorization or location/tariff publication.
features.acceptance: Publish eligible locations and tariffs; accept an external card through a contracted partner; produce and settle the matching charge record.

features.name: Ad-hoc QR/card payments and receipts
features.currentEvidence: No checkout, terminal or receipt flow.
features.acceptance: On an eligible public deployment, disclose price, authorize payment, start charge, finalize actual cost, issue receipt and resolve failure/refund cases.

features.name: Public app start/stop and live session
features.currentEvidence: No public session commands or account authorization.
features.acceptance: Start and stop on supported partner networks with correct user authorization, timeout reconciliation and final pricing.

features.name: Support tickets with accountable ownership
features.currentEvidence: Delegate read tokens and diagnostics; no case management.
features.acceptance: Create a case from a session/payment/charger; preserve context, assign a human owner, show updates and close with a verified resolution.

features.name: Urgent assistance and field escalation
features.currentEvidence: No staffed support or field-service arrangements.
features.acceptance: Contract response coverage and escalation; exercise a real blocked-cable/fault scenario and dispatch workflow before advertising that service.

features.name: Monitoring, alerts and incident operations
features.currentEvidence: Health and live station state exist; no alert routing, incident duty or service metrics.
features.acceptance: Detect an outage, notify the responsible operator, record incident history and validate customer communication and recovery.

features.name: Reversible migration and record continuity
features.currentEvidence: Migration dossier, manifest and runbooks exist; external tooling performs the switch.
features.acceptance: Preserve old records and financial cut-off, prove local rollback, switch only in an authorized window, and reconcile both sides without duplicates or gaps.

features.name: Scoped access, privacy and audit
features.currentEvidence: Owner root, pseudonymized edge audit and expiring read capabilities; separate local account/session and organization isolation with resource-ID audit. Commercial retention/deletion, household grants and support-access audit remain incomplete.
features.acceptance: Verify account/tenant/session scopes, retention, access/export/deletion handling and support-access auditing; employer sees only eligible business data.

features.name: Commercial backup and disaster recovery
features.currentEvidence: Single-station encrypted recovery exists; multi-station continuity explicitly blocked.
features.acceptance: Restore every supported tenant/station, current credentials, authorization state, financial ledger and replay identities onto fresh infrastructure.

features.name: Historical imports and shadow reconciliation
features.currentEvidence: Generic browser-only CSV mapping and original-byte provenance at /observe. Actual vendor-format and statement/bank adapters still need implementation and authorized source evidence.
features.acceptance: Import authorized device/provider/statement data read-only; record provenance; detect source gaps; compare without contacting or modifying the live charger.

features.name: Documented API and accounting/payroll exports
features.currentEvidence: Typed owner API exists; no commercial integration contract.
features.acceptance: Version APIs and exports; enforce narrow credentials; retry imports safely; validate a real customer accounting or payroll handoff.

features.name: Languages, accessibility and mobile delivery
features.currentEvidence: No verified localization, accessibility or installed-app delivery contract.
features.acceptance: Complete critical flows in agreed launch languages, initially NL/FR/EN; keyboard/screen-reader and phone QA; select native or PWA delivery against actual notification needs.

features.name: Quotes, appointments, inspection and maintenance
features.currentEvidence: Runbooks only; no order-to-install or field-service system.
features.acceptance: Offer a priced scope, approve/schedule work, record installer handover and inspection evidence, and route maintenance/warranty cases to a responsible partner.

features.name: Owner exit and portable recovery
features.currentEvidence: Open source and encrypted continuity format; cross-host restore still needs field proof.
features.acceptance: Owner exports usable state and moves to another supported deployment without losing essential authorization or evidence.

features.name: Employer change and ownership transfer
features.currentEvidence: Offboarding closes future business eligibility and preserves financial snapshots; reviewed unpaid corrections can resolve resulting balance changes. Formal financial-period closing, household grants and physical ownership transfer remain incomplete.
features.acceptance: Close financial periods, revoke employer rights, preserve household ownership and charging, and explicitly approve any ownership transfer.

features.name: Reseller branding and delegated administration
features.currentEvidence: No reseller/brand hierarchy.
features.acceptance: Separate reseller, operator, employer and owner authority; branded domains/apps never grant cross-customer access.

features.name: Broader hardware, protocols and depot operations
features.currentEvidence: Only the OCPP 1.6J owner-edge baseline; no verified broad hardware catalogue.
features.acceptance: Add each exact AC/DC model, firmware and protocol with real interoperability, recovery and power-management evidence; no brand-wide compatibility claim.

features.name: Extended energy products and flexibility
features.currentEvidence: No solar/battery commercial offering or flexibility services.
features.acceptance: Define the separately sold energy outcome and integrations; prove controls, contracts, support and settlement before representing broader energy-company parity.
